title: Taxonomy of Causal Links in the AI Control Failure Chain

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A taxonomy is useful for organizing research but does not directly produce safety improvements. Impact depends on whether the field adopts the taxonomy. The gap analysis component adds value by identifying neglected areas.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Literature survey and classification work requires reading and synthesis, not advanced ML skills. CS students at beginner level can do this with guidance on the literature. No compute requirements beyond basic document management.

narrow_scope.reasoning: A comprehensive taxonomy of evasion tactics across all literature and red-team transcripts could expand indefinitely. Needs a clear boundary on which sources to survey. Doable in 30 hours if scoped to 10-15 key papers, but the 'survey existing literature' framing is open-ended.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
